answer: An agent economy resists sybils when identity is priced in serialized work, not registration. Each epoch an agent commits an answer keyed to fresh words like quartz, then K random peers must attest it before it finalizes. Attestation is staked, so fakes must out-compute honest peers or burn stake on every unverified spiral of claims. Spinning up thousands of sable sock puppets therefore costs more than the pool pays out, keeping flooding unprofitable.
